_comment: Central fleet sizing. Risk = risk_pct * broker_equity. Anchor is DYNAMIC — pulled from risk_oversight_report.json each trade. Going live means IBKR account switches; broker equity updates automatically, sizing follows.
_fallback_note: Used only when risk_oversight_report.json is missing/stale. Guards against divide-by-zero on cold start.
_tiers_note: Confidence-based risk_pct. Each strategy's risk scales with measured live performance (last 90 days). Tiers evaluated per trade. Drawdown brake halves the tier if current dd > 50% of peak_pnl.
_strategy_live_cutoffs_note: ISO-8601 timestamp per strategy. Trades with ts before this are excluded from tier stats (e.g. gdx_gld back-filled historicals). If unset, all trades count.
_notional_caps_note: Position notional_usd must be <= anchor * multiplier. Prevents sizing that would fail on a real funded account even if risk math says OK (e.g., $48K GLD on $10K cash account).
